in_marathi.name: Umang
in_marathi.long_meaning: Umang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Uma' which means 'radiant, brilliant'. In Hindu mythology, Umang is believed to be the name of the god Shiva's son.
